OEM easy installation: Visit the web-interface at 192.168.8.1 Note: The ethernet port is by default WAN. So you need to connect to the router via WiFi
Navigate to the Update tab on the left side.
Upload the OpenWrt sysupgrade image. Note: Make sure you select not to preserve the configuration.
Installation via U-Boot: Hold down the reset button while powering on the device. Wait for the LED to flash 5 times.
Assign yourself a static IPv4 in 192.168.1.0/24
Upload the OpenWrt sysupgrade image at 192.168.1.1.

openwrt_git.titel: ramips: add support for GL.iNet microuter-N300
openwrt_git.beschreibung: The GL.iNet microuter-N300 (internally referred as MT300N-v4) is a pocket-size travel router. It is essentially identical to the VIXMINI (internally referred as MT300N-v3) but with double the RAM and SPI-flash. Additionally, set the label-mac for both the VIXMINI as well as the microuter-N300.

openwrt_git.Installation via U-Boot: Hold reset while powering on, wait for LED to flash 5 times; static IPv4 in 192.168.1.0/24; upload sysupgrade image at 192.168.1.1
